thread:
devin_eng: starting rolling deploy llm-router v6 -> will enable feature flag llm_route_v6 for canary cohort at 22:00 UTC (10% traffic).
deploy-bot: deploy job queued: deploy/llm-router/v6 -> canary-eu. CI green, smoke passed. Auto-ramp plan: 10% -> 25% after 30m if health OK. link: https://ci.redwood/llm-router/5678
maria_pm: quick note — pin session_sticky=true for canary to avoid cross-cohort contamination.
anita_release: added release note draft: "kv-cache refactor; monitor memory".
ops_robin: calendar updated for change window 22:00-23:30 UTC. oncall confirmed.
sre_oncall: I'll monitor memory & gc. If p95 mem >= +5% sustained, we hold/rollback.
deploy-bot: 22:06 UTC: started ramp to 10%. Telemetry: latency nominal, errors 0.02%, mem +1.5% avg.
devin_eng: seeing a subset of hosts with higher heap drift and occasional 150ms GC pauses. Collecting traces.
sre_oncall: three hosts reporting steady heap incline (canary-eu-2,4,7). Pausing ramp. HOLD engaged.
deploy-bot: Hold acknowledged. Current state snapshot saved. To rollback: /deploy rollback llm-router --to v5 --scope canary-eu
maria_pm: propose soak for 15m while devs triage; prepare rollback steps if it worsens.
devin_eng: agree. grabbing heapdumps from the affected hosts now.
anita_release: updating public release notes: "canary ramp paused due to memory signal; investigating".
sre_oncall: 22:14 UTC: canary-eu-7 p95 mem +5.6% and GC >200ms. executing rollback for canary slice.
deploy-bot: executing rollback: /deploy rollback llm-router --to v5 --scope canary-eu --force
ops_robin: unpinning session_sticky and setting flag llm_route_v6=0 for cohort canary-eu. command: /flag set llm_route_v6 0 --cohort=canary-eu --reason="mem regression"
devin_eng: traffic shifted off the hosts, memory drops observed quickly. collecting post-rollback traces.
anita_release: release notes updated: "v6 rollback on canary due to memory regression in kv-cache; investigation ongoing".
maria_pm: next steps: (1) dev to root-cause kv-cache growth and propose micro-patch, (2) run larger-seq perf tests, (3) plan muted reattempt with extra observability.
sre_oncall: opening incident ticket and attaching telemetry graphs. lowering canary alert threshold to auto-hold earlier on next attempt.
deploy-bot: rollback complete at 22:30 UTC. Canary traffic back to v5. No user-facing incidents reported.
devin_eng: heapdump diffs point to buffer accumulation when seq_len > 2048. will prototype fix in a feature branch.
anita_release: keeping thread as record for postmortem and customer comms.
ops_robin: noted action items and scheduling a follow-up deploy window next week after patch validation. :thumbsup:
